_comment: Edit 'status' to 'Tested' when verified in-game. Generated 2026-06-20 from v1.10.0; confidence fields added 2026-09-01 by feature-map regen for v1.16.3.

groups.name: Metal Sheet
groups.evidence: playtest T1.7 (2026-07-21) act_starter_smelting_chain; unchanged since. 1.18.0 per-metal pictures (Chiwei's 0928 set), gated by ACT-MetalVariantArt.Tests.ps1, not yet run in-game (tracker T2.752). 1.18.0 (Chiwei 1004 row 4, owner decision 2026-10-05): the Iron Sheet folded in as Metal Type 200 (named Iron Sheet, its old art); Bp_IronSheet makes it (6 iron nuggets, mask 448 plus the replace flag); every iron recipe gates the Metal Sheet to 200; the retired act_iron_sheet reforges itself after one tick (Progress OnFull transform, INFERRED) or by Reforge as Metal Sheet; research note Documentation/Research/AdvancedCopperTools/sheet-nail-merge.md; not yet run in-game (tracker T2.781, T2.782)

groups.name: Metal Nails
groups.evidence: playtest T1.7 (2026-07-21) act_starter_smelting_chain. 1.18.0 Tier B (Documentation/Design/AdvancedCopperTools_Metal_Variant_Art_As_Built.md step 3): Metal Type (SD4) on the nail, Bp_CopperNails widened to nuggets up to 140 with mask 256 and the replace flag, Bp_CastCopperNails (1.18.0, Chiwei 1004 row 3, tracker T2.780: 1 heated bar up to 140 + mud brick + clay makes 6, same mask 256 carry), per-metal names and Chiwei's art, looks only; gated by ACT-MetalVariantArt.Tests.ps1, not yet run in-game. 1.18.0 (Chiwei 1004 row 4): the card is named Metal Nail and the Iron Nail folded in as Metal Type 200 (Bp_IronNails makes 4 from 4 iron nuggets, mask 256 plus the replace flag); the retired act_iron_nail reforges itself after one tick or by Reforge as Metal Nail and stays accepted in every nail slot until then; tracker T2.781, T2.782

groups.name: Stove Top Mold / Cast Stove Top
groups.evidence: playtest T2.8 (2026-07-21) batch spot-check. Retired as a craft step 2026-10-05 (Chiwei 1004): the Cast Stove Top Mold blueprint left its tab, both cards still load, and the Cast Stove Top gained a Cut Up button (2 sheets of its own metal), not yet run in-game (tracker T2.774). 1.18.0 per-metal pictures (Chiwei's 0928 set), gated by ACT-MetalVariantArt.Tests.ps1, not yet run in-game (tracker T2.752)

groups.name: Wearable Metal Pan
groups.evidence: playtest T2.8 (2026-07-21) batch spot-check. 1.17.0 added Pan for Stream Tin (river-gated DA) to both pans; 1.18.0 removed it from the Shaped Metal Pan Head (tin sells far above a copper bar), so only the Wearable Metal Pan pans, not yet run in-game (tracker T2.322). Perk_MetalPanTester (dead dev perk, never unlockable) removed in 1.16.4. 1.18.0 (Chiwei's rebalance): weight 300, capacity 1600, ContentWeightReduction -1600, pan blank from 1 Metal Sheet, wearable recipe 3 twine + 1 wood, hammer slot GpTag_ACT_ShapingHammer, both unlocked by a Metal Sheet; static half gated by ACT-PanStoveWiring.Tests.ps1, not yet run in-game (tracker T2.459-T2.461). 1.18.0 per-metal pictures (Chiwei's 0928 set), gated by ACT-MetalVariantArt.Tests.ps1, not yet run in-game (tracker T2.752); the Shaped Metal Pan Head draws one heated picture above 150 Temperature (cold rows FuelRange 0-150, heated 151-1300), not yet run in-game (tracker T2.759); 2026-10-09 the head gained vanilla metal-blank cooling passives (it never cooled out of a forge, T2.787 FAIL), rerun pending

groups.name: Copper Stove
groups.evidence: playtest T2.8 (2026-07-21) base + T2.85 (2026-08-15) Firekeeping duty compat. 1.17.0 added the fire passives (drying, light, bugs, Stealth), not yet run in-game (tracker T2.320). 1.18.0 (Chiwei's rebalance): 600 weight capacity in place of 2 slots, fuel kept across Pick Up and Place, +75 Sanctuary placed, unlocked by a Metal Sheet, Cast Stove Top Mold with no research; not yet run in-game (tracker T2.459, T2.460, T2.462). 1.18.0 Tier B (Documentation/Design/AdvancedCopperTools_Metal_Variant_Art_As_Built.md step 3): Metal Type (SD4) on all three stove cards taken from the sheets (mask 256, stack filter, stove-top mask 0, replace flag), TransferSpecial4 on all five transforms, per-metal names and Chiwei's art, Sanctuary and lit burn rate by Metal-Type-gated PassiveEffects (tunable placeholders); gated by ACT-PanStoveWiring.Tests.ps1 and ACT-MetalVariantArt.Tests.ps1, not yet run in-game (tracker T2.761). 2026-10-05 (Chiwei 1004, pack Prompt 27): two-stage blueprint (crucible, 2 mud bricks, 2 clay; then 4 sheets, 4 copper nails, hammer, solder) absorbing the Cast Stove Top, weight 600, Place and Pick Up one mini tick, Dismantle returns 4 sheets; fuel retention reviewed in Documentation/Research/AdvancedCopperTools/stove-fuel-through-place-and-pick-up.md, not yet run in-game (tracker T2.774 and T2.775)

Includes the 3 brewed teas (CookingRecipe outputs, no independent blueprint). 1.18.0: Grind All keeps each herb's spoilage and quality as its hand grind does and charges its 2-tick DaytimeCost; not yet run in-game (tracker T2.753)

groups.name: Metal Armor (one card per piece, every metal)
groups.evidence: ACT 1.18.13 armor merge (owner decisions D4, A1-A5, 2026-10-22): the four copper UIDs are the one helmet, armor, bracers and greaves card and blueprint for every metal; Metal Type (SpecialDurability4) picks name, art, location armor (ArmorValueDurabilitiesMultiplier), weight, trade value and passive effects, each equal to the old per-metal card (Development_Tools/Tests/ACT-ArmorMerge.Tests.ps1 reads the pre-merge blobs at 713533229); spiritual ward by Patcher/ArmorWardPatch.cs (ACT-ArmorWard.Tests.ps1). Not yet run in game: harness T2.2000-T2.2003, T2.2005, T2.2006, person T2.2007. Before the merge: VERIFIED via T2.6 (2026-07-21) for the copper set.

groups.name: Iron Armor Set
groups.evidence: RETIRED 2026-10-22 by the ACT 1.18.13 armor merge (owner decision D4; Documentation/Design/AdvancedCopperTools_Armor_Merge_As_Built.md): these cards and blueprints stay loadable for old saves only. Each card reforges into the merged card of its piece at its own Metal Type (hidden Progress OnFull Transform plus a Reforge button); each blueprint is out of BlueprintTabs.json with empty conditions and AlsoUnlocks the merged blueprint. Gated by Development_Tools/Tests/ACT-ArmorMerge.Tests.ps1; old-save reforge and research carry-over are harness T2.2002 and T2.2003. Before the merge: Breastplate M/F gendered split VERIFIED via T2.32 (2026-07-21); Helmet/Gauntlets/Greaves share the mechanic but have no dedicated test citation. 1.18.0 (Chiwei 1004 row 4): every iron recipe takes Metal Sheets of Metal Type 200 (element gate, FilterStackWithDurability 256 and the CardsOnBoard gate) and Metal Nails of any metal; dismantles return Metal Sheets and Nails stamped 200; not yet run in-game (tracker T2.781)

groups.name: Iron Shield and Ghost Bronze Shield

Each card reforges into the merged card of its piece at its own Metal Type (hidden Progress OnFull Transform plus a Reforge button); each blueprint is out of BlueprintTabs.json with empty conditions and AlsoUnlocks the merged blueprint. groups.name: Bedwarming Pan
groups.evidence: new in 1.18.0 (2026-10-02, plan D2): cold pan with a Fill with Embers CI on tag_Fire / tag_FireSource (WorksBothWays) transforming into a hot pan whose Fuel drains over 40 ticks and whose OnZero returns the cold pan; the hot pan carries vanilla ClothLarge's Warmth when Sleeping PassiveEffect at TemperaturePerceived +3 (tunable) and tag_Bedding, the runtime name of the BedLog and BedImprovised InventoryFilter tag measured in wave 0 (W0-7). No sleep with the pan was run yet (tracker row for a winter night with and without it).

groups.name: Copper-Buckled Tool Belt
groups.evidence: 2026-10-12 owner art review: 6 InventorySlots (null placeholders) and the InventoryFilter widened to vanilla sickles, spoon augers, fire strikers, whetstone and metal/bone needles. New in 1.18.0 (2026-10-02, plan D3): a CT0 equippable (InHandWhenEquipped) on a NEW ACT equipment tag act_eTag_ToolBelt (ScriptableObject/EquipmentTag, MaxEquipped 1; owner decision 2026-10-02 that the belt must not share the knife sheath's eTag_Pouch or the spear sheath's eTag_Belt); InventoryFilter CardFilters by vanilla GUID (metal, flint, bone and obsidian knives, three hammers, the chisel; positive filters are OR), weight capacity 1200, ContentWeightReduction -200, WeightReductionWhenEquipped -250 (tunable placeholders); blueprint needs a copper sheet, medium leather and 4 copper nails with a hammer; blueprint slots still need the tool dragged in (InspectionPopup.AutoFill ignores equipped cards). Not yet run in a game: the new tag's runtime resolution, the equip beside both sheaths and the Mark Trees check are the harness scenario T2.766 (tracker T2.766); no vanilla action needs a hammer on the player, so the hammer is covered by acceptance and weight only.

groups.name: Cautery Iron
groups.evidence: new in 1.18.0 (2026-10-02, plan E2): cold act_cautery_iron with a Heat in Fire CI on tag_Fire / tag_FireSource (WorksBothWays) transforming into act_cautery_iron_hot, whose Fuel (Heat, 4, -1 a tick) running out returns the cold iron; the hot iron carries five Cauterize CIs (WorksInverted, the wound is the given card, by GUID: the two arm and two leg lacerations and the minor laceration, W0-11) that transform each wound into its Stitched twin in GivenCardChanges, produce W_FireBurn as vanilla's fire events do, add 60 to the new ACT effect stat act_stat_cautery_burn (statuses raise Pain by a global +15 / +30, never a base write) and 30 Stress; blueprint 1 vanilla MetalBarFinished gated to Metal Type 100 and 1 long stick. Gated by StatBase-NoVanillaSource, DurabilityStat-FieldNames, Csproj-ContentIncludes and the card-art gates; the harness scenario and tracker row are written and not yet run in a game (whether ProducedCards from a CardOnCardAction CI lands the burn is the scenario's first read).

groups.name: Copper Spigot
groups.evidence: new in 1.18.0 (2026-10-02, plan E1, transform route chosen by W0-10): act_copper_spigot (1 Metal Sheet + 1 Tin Solder, Metal Tools tab) carries two WorksInverted Fit Spigot CIs, one per vanilla tap GUID, whose GivenCardChanges transform the tap into act_sap_tap_spigot or act_resin_tap_spigot (copies of the vanilla taps: one inventory slot, the tag_WaterContainer filter, both cooking recipes, the Refresh CI on tag_Cutter, Special3 draining at -0.3333 a point against -1), carrying TransferInventory and TransferSpecial3, and whose ReceivingCardChanges destroys the spigot; each copy has a Remove Spigot DA that transforms back to the vanilla tap with the same flags and produces the spigot. Gated by DurabilityStat-FieldNames, Blueprint-TabGroupNames, CardData-Integrity and the card-art gates; the harness scenario and tracker row are written and not yet run in a game (whether the real tap's bowl and sap survive the transform is the scenario's first read; if not, the plan builds the remote RemotePassiveEffects branch).

groups.name: Grappling Hook
groups.evidence: new in 1.18.0 (2026-10-02, plan E3, carried branch chosen by W0-12): act_grappling_hook (CT0, no durability) carries one PassiveEffects entry with no OnlyWhenEquipped, OnlyWhenInHand or PlayerUsesCard condition raising ClimbingAid (33f8297bdbbdf7a47b9944f633fdcad8, range 0-288) by ValueModifier 72; act_bp_grappling_hook takes 3 MetalNugget at Special4 100 and 1 Rope with a hammering tool not spent, on the Metal Tools tab. No climb card is edited. Gated by CardData-Integrity, Blueprint-TabGroupNames and the card-art gates; the harness scenario and tracker row are written and not yet run in a game.

groups.name: Copper Shears (with Sirus23)
groups.evidence: new in 1.18.0 (2026-10-02, plan F3, postfix branch chosen by W0-15): act_copper_shears (CT0) carries tag_Shears spelled as Sirus23_Mod_Collection/CardData/Item/Shears.json spells it, beside tag_Tool, tag_Metal and tag_SmeltsAt1100, with UsageDurability 30 and an OnZero destroy (Sirus's own shears have no OnZero, and the Shear CI checks no given-card durability, so without it the copper pair would never wear out); act_bp_copper_shears takes 1 Metal Sheet at Special4 0-100 and 1 Copper Nail with a hammering tool not spent, on the Metal Tools tab. Patcher/PartnerBlueprintGatePatch.cs (named CopperShearsGatePatch until the Fleet plan feature 6 table) postfixes GameManager.InitializeStatsAndActions and, when sh_shears does not resolve, sets the blueprint's BlueprintModelStates entry to Hidden and its UnlockableCards entry Disabled unless already Available; every null exit has a per-cause warn-once. Gated by ACT-CrossModTags (watched red on the real tree with Sirus23 left out), CardData-Integrity, Blueprint-TabGroupNames, DurabilityStat-FieldNames and the card-art gates; the harness scenario and tracker row are written and not yet run in a game.
